title: MCP3208 inputs: model against the datasheet
covers: the model of the monitor converter U40
summary: Nine frames select the eight channels in turn and channel 7 once more. Channels 0 to 6 stand at different voltages on stiff sources, so the voltage on the sampling capacitor shows which channel a frame selects and when. Channel 7 is a capacitor of 100 nF without a source: what a sample takes from it is the charge of the sampling capacitor. A second deck forces 1 mA through the diodes of a pin.

notes: The model samples and holds; the conversion, the data output and the errors of the converter (offset 3 LSB, gain 5 LSB, linearity 1 LSB at the most) are not in it.

The sampling capacitor keeps the voltage of the channel before: an assumption about the capacitor array, which the datasheet does not describe. The benches of the monitors also run the case of a capacitor that starts 2.5 V away.
The diode drop of 0.6 V at 1 mA is the threshold that the datasheet draws; the current is an assumption.
